name: Bug tracker
summary: From new report to verified fix, with severity and area labels.

lists.name: New
lists.description: Untriaged reports. Triage within a day: reproduce it, set a severity and an area, then move it on or close it as a duplicate.

lists.name: Triaged
lists.description: Confirmed and prioritised, most severe first. Critical bugs jump the queue.

lists.name: Fixing
lists.description: Someone is fixing it now, at most 3 at a time. Agents: take the top Triaged card, reproduce it, fix it and leave a note of the cause.

lists.name: Verify
lists.description: A fix is ready; the reporter or QA confirms it on a real build.

lists.name: Closed
lists.description: Fixed and verified, or closed as not reproducible, duplicate or won't fix. Say why in a comment.

cards.name: Saving a draft sometimes loses the last paragraph
cards.description:
**Repro steps**
1. Open a draft and type for a few seconds
2. Switch tabs and come back
3. Click Save

**Expected**
All the text is saved.

**Actual**
The last paragraph is missing.

**Environment**
Browser, version, account.
